zh.title: NetJets賽斯納 Citation Longitude迫降俄亥俄州
zh.summary: NetJets班機於俄亥俄州迫降；機頭起落架未放下；兩名飛行員無恙
body: 一架由 NetJets 營運的賽斯納（Cessna）Citation Longitude 商務噴射機，於2026年8月18日在美國俄亥俄州阿克倫-坎頓機場（CAK）進行前起落架未放下的緊急迫降。該班機之航班號碼為 EJA803，由華盛頓杜勒斯國際機場（IAD）飛往阿克倫-坎頓機場，在準備降落時因前起落架無法正常放下而發生異常狀況。
根據現場降落影片顯示，該架飛機降落時先以主起落架觸地。飛行員在機頭接觸跑道前，成功將機頭保持在跑道上方懸空數秒以減速，隨後機頭才隨著航機減速而著陸於跑道地面上。本次迫降事件造成該架飛機的機頭與機身底部受損。
根據俄亥俄州公路巡警（Ohio State Highway Patrol）表示，當時機上共有兩名飛行員，兩人在事發後均順利離開機艙且未受傷，機上當時並無搭乘任何乘客。格林市消防局（City of Green Fire Division）與阿克倫-坎頓機場救援小組於當地時間約 12:53 接獲通報並前往現場處置。
美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）登記資料顯示，涉事飛機註冊號碼為 N803QS，為 2020 年製造之特克斯隆航空（Textron Aviation）Model 700 Citation Longitude 機型。航班追蹤資料顯示，該機於當地時間 10:48 自華盛頓杜勒斯國際機場起飛，並於 12:54 抵達阿克倫-坎頓機場。目前前起落架故障之具體原因尚未確定。
Citation Longitude 為賽斯納現行商務噴射機產品線中尺寸最大的機型。NetJets 於 2018 年訂購多達 175 架該款機型（包含 50 架確認訂單與 125 架選購權），成為該機型的首發客戶。該型超中型噴射機配備兩具霍尼韋爾（Honeywell）HTF7700L 渦輪扇發動機，最大航程為 3,500 海浬。

en.title: NetJets Citation Longitude makes nose-gear-up landing in Ohio
en.summary: A NetJets Citation Longitude made a nose-gear-up emergency landing in Ohio; two pilots were uninjured.
body: A NetJets Cessna Citation Longitude business jet made an emergency landing with its nose landing gear retracted at Akron-Canton Airport (CAK) in Ohio on August 18, 2026. The flight was operating as NetJets Flight EJA803 from Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD) to Akron-Canton when its nose landing gear failed to extend during arrival.

According to video footage of the landing, the aircraft touched down on its main landing gear first. The pilots held the nose off the runway surface for several seconds as the aircraft decelerated before the nose settled onto the pavement. The aircraft sustained damage to its nose section and underside during the occurrence.

Two pilots were on board the aircraft and exited without injury, according to the Ohio State Highway Patrol. No passengers were aboard the flight. Emergency responders from the City of Green Fire Division and Akron-Canton Airport emergency crews attended the scene after the landing occurred at approximately 12:53 local time.

Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) registry records identify the aircraft, registered as N803QS, as a 2020 Textron Aviation Model 700 Citation Longitude. Flight tracking data showed it departed Washington Dulles at 10:48 and arrived at Akron-Canton at 12:54. The precise cause of the landing gear malfunction has not been determined.

The Citation Longitude is the largest aircraft in Cessna's current business jet lineup. NetJets became the launch customer for the super-midsize type after ordering up to 175 Longitudes in 2018, comprising 50 firm orders and 125 options. The aircraft is powered by two Honeywell HTF7700L turbofan engines with a maximum range of 3,500 nautical miles.

zh.title: Ampaire完成1900萬美元B輪融資 IAG與阿拉斯加航空參投
zh.summary: Ampaire獲1900萬美元B輪融資；IAG與阿拉斯加航空等機構參投。
body: 美國混合動力航空業者 Ampaire 宣布完成 1,900 萬美元的 B 輪融資，由 DiamondStream Partners 領投。本輪融資使其累計融資總額達到 6,800 萬美元。參與投資的機構包含國際航空集團（IAG）與阿拉斯加航空（Alaska Airlines）旗下的風險投資部門。
Ampaire 規劃將新資金用於加速其 AMP-H570 混合動力推進系統的商業化進程。該系統用於改裝塞斯納大篷車（Cessna Grand Caravan）飛機，旨在將燃油消耗降低一半。此外，該公司亦獲選參與由美國政府與美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）支持的電動垂直起降整合試點計畫（eIPP）。

en.title: Ampaire Raises $19M Series B Funding from IAG and Alaska Airlines VC Arms
en.summary: Ampaire secures $19 million in Series B funding with backing from IAG and Alaska Airlines.
body: California-based hybrid-electric aircraft developer Ampaire has raised $19 million in a Series B funding round led by DiamondStream Partners. The new capital brings the company's total funding raised to date to $68 million. Investors participating in the round include the venture capital arms of International Air Group (IAG) and Alaska Airlines, as well as multiple venture capital firms.

Ampaire will deploy the funds to accelerate the commercial readiness of its AMP-H570 hybrid-electric propulsion system, which is retrofitted onto Cessna Grand Caravan aircraft to halve fuel consumption. Additionally, the startup has been selected to participate in the eVTOL Integration Pilot Program (eIPP) supported by the U.S. government and the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA).
